text:
marta: Drafting 2.12.0 release notes (runtime hotfix + routing fallback tweaks). Need quick ops/docs/legal eyes so I can pin and schedule. Pin target: 2024-12-05 16:00 PT. Deploy window: 2024-12-06 01:00-05:00 UTC. Any embargoes for APAC?
noah: Add clear rollback criteria. Suggest: revert if client error rate > 1.7% sustained for 6m OR p95 token latency +200ms for >10m. Revert tag: `revert/2.12.0`. Also list exact revert command.
anya: Docs: please add a short curl example for the `truncate` flag and call out "version pin (artifact SHA)" in user-facing text. I can drop the snippet in the draft.
deploy-bot: INFO: Canary plan: 5% -> 30% -> 100% with 10m ramps. Auto-rollback if canary error delta >1.2% vs baseline. Preview: `/deploy start v2.12.0 --canary=5 --ramp=10m --annotations=\"comms:autopost\"`
marta: Added revert tag + rollback steps to the draft and a Dedicated FAQ blurb on quiesce. Draft link: https://docs.internal/releases/2.12.0-draft.
noah: I can run final smoke 01:00-03:00 UTC (US region). Smoke checklist: health, 3 gen prompts, 2 embeddings, KV warmup, routing fallback test. Will post logs here.
anya: I pushed the curl snippet to the doc and tweaked wording. Recommend autopost happen at 30% canary so oncall sees early signal.
marta: OK pinning at 2024-12-05 16:00 PT unless objections. I will set deploybot annotation to `comms:autopost` so internal announce runs automatically at the chosen canary step.
noah: 44d ready for smoke.
deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: Deploy scheduled to start 2024-12-06T01:00:00Z. Manifest `manifest-2.12.0.json` attached. Annotations set to trigger internal announce at 30%.
marta: Thanks team  will watch canary and post final pinned link.
